audit.whatIsWrong: Every side token disagreed with its own why: rows 1, 2 and 5 read Ornn while their whys said 'even'/'skill'/'even', rows 4 and 6 read Skill and Ornn while their whys said 'favouring you', and row 0 read Skill while its why said the stage favours Ornn.
audit.why: The content whys were already consistent with the packet chart (Ornn / Skill / Skill / Skill / Vladimir / Skill / Vladimir) — only the tokens were wrong, in both layers identically. Ornn owns level 1 with Bellows Breath, the middle is CS and cooldown discipline, and Vladimir's kill windows are level 6 and two items, which fits a 48.1% lane where the tank out-values him in fights but not in the side lane.
audit.corrected: Six rows flipped to the packet chart in phases[N].side and win[N] as one paired atomic group; no why needed rewriting for side, because the prose was right all along.

audit.why: Entry counts unchanged; spike timings (level 6, first item, late) already match where the kill windows are.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0].text and whys[0] describe Ornn walking up 'shielding' with a 'Brittle-shield' pattern, and neither states how the knockup is actually set up.
audit.why: Riot's W text has no shield in it — Bellows Breath advances breathing fire and the final gout applies Brittle. The real combo the page never states is that Volcanic Rupture leaves a magma pillar at the end of the fissure, and Searing Charge knocks up when it collides with terrain: he makes his own wall, then charges into it. Against a champion with no dash, whose only escape is 2 seconds of Sanguine Pool on 28s at rank 1, standing between Ornn and any wall — his or the map's — is what loses the trade.
audit.corrected: spikes[0].text, whys[0], dontsFull[0].d and dontsFull[1].d rewritten around Brittle and the Q-pillar into E-knockup sequence. No shield claim written.

audit.whatIsWrong: The 'terrain-cuts-retreat' interaction was absent from the page.
audit.why: Both Volcanic Rupture and Searing Charge create or use terrain, and Vladimir has no dash — Flash is the answer to the wall, not to the damage.
audit.corrected: Written into spikes[0].text and dontsFull[0].d as the concrete 'never fight with a wall behind you' rule.
